summary_1line: Karna and Sakuni persuade Duryodhana to visit Dwaitavana under a cattle‑inspection pretext despite Dhritarashtra’s warnings about the nearby exiled Pandavas.

image_candidates.scene_text: Karna, Duryodhana, and Sakuni clasp hands and laugh together in secret agreement over their scheme.
The blind king Dhritarashtra sits on his throne warning anxiously while the princes stand before him requesting permission.
Duryodhana departs with a massive retinue—chariots, elephants, horses, soldiers, traders, and nobles—rolling like a storm toward the forest of Dwaitavana.
